versions.content: Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndi- cation_<CGI> Service Name Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> Syntax void Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> ( CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId, Std_ReturnType result ) Service ID [hex] 0x010b Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant ComUserCbkHandleId Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API Parameters (in) result E_OK : The I-PDU was received successfully. E_NOT_OK : Reception of the I-PDU failed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Rte_Rips_NotifyTpRxIndication will be called to notify the RTE Implementation Plug-In when an I-PDU is received via the TP for the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation, with the result indicating whether the transmission was successful or not. This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom TP Rte_LdComCbkTpRx Indication callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00650] for more details on the functionality of this callback. Available via Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
